title: 9 Habits a Godly Man Builds Before Anyone's Watching
caption:
None of these go on your resume.

Wakes up before he has to. Does the boring rep no one will notice. Finishes what he starts, even the small stuff. Rests on purpose instead of just collapsing. Thanks God for the job before he complains about it.

Excellence is mostly invisible work, done on repeat. The unclaimed job is where trust gets built.

#faith #work #discipline #christianmen #manofgod
